extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax payable
extracted.summary: An executor of his late aunt's estate, mostly a Reading property worth about £755,000 with little cash, asks to borrow around £59,500 to pay inheritance tax before the grant is issued.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding inheritance tax on your late aunt's estate. We have noted the estate value of approximately £755,000 and the £59,500 of inheritance tax you need to pay before the grant can issue. To take this further we would need a copy of the will, details of your appointment as executor, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, confirmation of the property's valuation and any mortgage or charge on it, the HMRC figures and any payment deadline, and written confirmation that Crossley Solicitors LLP are instructed and able to act on the estate's behalf. Identification documents for you as executor will also be required. Once we have those we will review the matter and come back to you.
